source_instruction: i am looking for a heavy duty red case for a galaxy s21 fe that is easy to install.
query: I spent 20 minutes this morning trying to hang a floating shelf in my bathroom and the cheap plastic wall anchors I had snapped right in half, leaving a crumbly hole in the drywall I had to spackle over while my cat kept trying to bat the spackle knife off the counter. My roommate walked in halfway through laughing so hard he spilled his oat milk latte all over the bath mat, which meant I had to throw that in the wash too before I could even finish patching the wall. I’ve heard that the cell phones over here are super easy to install, built heavy duty to hold up to all kinds of rough daily use, and come in a nice red finish, all for under $40.
